backward_compat_traps.rule: Link training is strictly Clock Recovery (TPS1) THEN Channel Equalization (TPS2/3/4).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Skipping CR or starting EQ before CR_DONE on all lanes leaves the link untrained.

backward_compat_traps.rule: RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3 use 8b/10b; UHBR uses 128b/132b with mandatory FEC.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming 8b/10b at UHBR rates (or omitting FEC at UHBR) breaks the link.

backward_compat_traps.rule: FEC must be enabled whenever DSC is used (and always for UHBR).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Running DSC without FEC corrupts compressed video on symbol errors.

backward_compat_traps.rule: EDID lives in the Sink's I2C ROM (A0h) reached by I2C-over-AUX; DPCD is a separate native-AUX space.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Trying to read EDID from the DPCD address space (or vice versa) fails.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The Main Link clock is embedded and recovered by the Sink (no clock lane).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Designing for a forwarded/source-synchronous Main Link clock is wrong for DisplayPort.

backward_compat_traps.rule: On training failure the Source must fall back to a lower rate and/or fewer lanes.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Failing to implement fallback breaks interop with marginal cables/sinks.

fields.spec_version: VESA DisplayPort (DP) Standard — DP 1.4a (2018) / DP 2.0 (2019) / DP 2.1 (2022)
previous_versions: DP 1.0 (2006) — RBR/HBR 8b/10b, AUX/DPCD, link training, SST.

key_changes.summary: DSC 1.2a corrections on top of DP 1.4 (DSC + FEC + HDR; HBR3 8.1 Gbps/lane).

Adds the UHBR tier (UHBR10/13.5/20 Gbps/lane) with 128b/132b coding and mandatory FEC, up to 80 Gbps total; Panel Replay; new VSC SDP usage. The 8b/10b RBR..HBR3 rates, AUX/DPCD, two-phase CR/EQ training, MSA/TU micro-packet stream, MST, and HDCP are carried forward.
Aligns DisplayPort with USB4 (DP-Alt-Mode tunneling), adds DP40/DP80 cable certification, and tightens UHBR conformance; same UHBR rates and architecture.

fields.version_naming_history_note: DisplayPort is a VESA standard. DP 1.0 (2006) established the Main Link + AUX/DPCD + 8b/10b + two-phase training + SST; MST arrived in 1.2 (with HBR2), HBR3 in 1.3, DSC/FEC/HDR in 1.4/1.4a, and the UHBR (128b/132b) tier in 2.0, with USB4 alignment + DP40/DP80 in 2.1. Facts here are grounded in the public VESA DisplayPort Standard (rates RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3 + UHBR10/13.5/20, AUX/DPCD, CR/EQ training, MSA/TU micro-packets, MST, HDCP/FEC/DSC).

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: VESA's internal-panel variant with Panel Self-Refresh / Panel Replay and additional low-power features; tracks the DP main-spec generations.
